Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the clear recap. Good call here — some answers from our side to help you route this correctly: 

1) Payment method: We prefer a PO / Net30 for any vendor that will be invoicing regularly and especially for production pilots > $5k/month. Corporate card is OK for a short proof-of-concept or if an expedited purchase is needed, but procurement will push for PO for pilot-to-production.

2) Vendor setup: Our AP team requires the following to create a vendor record: W-9 (US vendors), COI (if hosting or data access is involved), and a completed vendor intake form (attached). We use Coupa internally for purchase orders — vendor needs to be created there before we can issue a PO.

3) Marketplace: If Redwood is available through a supported marketplace and we can get equivalent commercial terms/invoice visibility, procurement considers marketplace buys easier — but only if it doesn't add additional markup and supports Net30 invoicing.

4) Contracting: Standard SOW + Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is usually sufficient. Legal may request minor redlines around data handling; we can share a redline packet if needed.

AP contact / portal:
- procurement@novacare.io (vendor intake)
- Vendor portal: https://novacare.coupa.com/vendor/portal

I've attached our vendor intake form for your team to complete (Novacare-Vendor-Intake-Form.pdf). If you can provide a Net30 quote and confirm you can accept a PO, I'll route for approval. If you need the COI language we require, let me know and I'll pull it.

Thanks — happy to coordinate with Marissa/Finance directly.

Best,
Anjali Gupta
Procurement Manager, Novacare Health
anjali@novacare.io
